run_flask_viewer_app: run the flask app to serve the Open-EQA viewer on localhost with debug mode enabled
get_video_by_index: post a JSON index to the /get_video endpoint to retrieve a specific video dataset entry
get_random_video_index: call the /get_random_index endpoint to get a random index into the Open-EQA dataset
render_index_page: visit the root route to render the index.html template for the viewer front end
load_and_filter_dataset: load the open-eqa-v0.json dataset, add video paths, and filter out entries with missing videos
